description: This file defines the CustomerService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, providing methods for managing Customer entities such as searching, counting, and retrieving customers via a data access object (CustomerDao).

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: Service class providing operations related to Customer entities, including searching, counting, and fetching customers by ID.

methods.name: getCustomerDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the CustomerDao instance used for database operations related to Customer entities.

methods.name: setCustomerDao
methods.description: Sets the CustomerDao instance to be used by this service.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Searches for customers based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by its unique identifier.
